title: Acceptance evaluation requested while a named verification is pending should wait for it, not go stale when the record lands
outcome: An evaluation request made while a named verification run is still pending waits for that record, or is evaluated against it, instead of becoming stale and needing another request. The source-freshness guard and verdict standards are unchanged.
acceptance: Recorded with file:line: where an evaluation becomes stale when a pending verification record lands, and the simplest way to queue or bind the evaluation to the named pending run. No new gate, and no weaker verdicts.

Behavioral test: an evaluation requested while a named verification is pending is judged against that record once it lands, without a second request. A source change after the request still makes the evaluation stale, with a message naming the cause and the correction.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
